description: Architectural description of the constraint system as it must evolve from v1 (PDF-only, hardcoded) to v2 (all-family, config-driven). Covers where constraints live, how they flow, and what guarantees they provide.

architecture_v1.description: PDF constraints are hardcoded in packet_builder.py. No other family has equivalent constraint injection.

repair_injection.mechanism: Filters packet.constraints for 'REQUIRED:' or 'FORBIDDEN:' prefix; re-injects into repair prompts
repair_injection.gap: Template hints and inline guidance NOT re-injected — only REQUIRED:/FORBIDDEN: survive repair

semantic_validation.gap: All other families have no semantic validation

architecture_v2.status: TARGET — to be implemented in Sprint R5 TC-SYS-03 + TC-SYS-04
architecture_v2.description: All constraints are config-driven, stored in family YAML per_type_constraints, read by packet_builder.py, and validated by a generalized code_generator.py validator.

constraint_locations.packet_builder: src/plugin_examples/generator/packet_builder.py reads per_type_constraints from family config and merges with hardcoded PDF block
constraint_locations.hardcoded_pdf: PRESERVED as fallback — packet_builder.py hardcoded PDF constraints remain active alongside config-driven constraints

supporting_using_directives: list of using statements required for fixture creation

repair_injection_v2.mechanism: Same filter as v1 — REQUIRED:/FORBIDDEN: prefix. Config-driven constraints use same prefix so they survive automatically.

logic.required_check: For each REQUIRED: constraint, extract token (text before first '(', trimmed). If token not in 'using' and token not found in code → add issue.
logic.forbidden_check: For each FORBIDDEN: constraint, extract token (first word after 'FORBIDDEN: '). If token found in code → add issue.
logic.using_check: For each REQUIRED: constraint containing 'using ', check full 'using X;' statement present in code.

semantic_validation_v2.applies_to: All families with per_type_constraints defined. Falls back to v1 PDF-only logic if no per_type_constraints.

generation_time: 1. Family YAML loaded → per_type_constraints extracted for target type
2. packet_builder.py merges hardcoded PDF constraints + config-driven constraints into packet.constraints
3. LLM receives full constraint list in generation prompt
5. _validate_code_from_constraints() scans for REQUIRED patterns and FORBIDDEN patterns
6. If validation fails → GENERATION_FAILED (code not written to disk)
7. If validation passes → code written; proceed to build
repair_time: 2. runner.py filters packet.constraints for REQUIRED:/FORBIDDEN: prefix
3. Filtered constraints re-injected into repair prompt
4. LLM receives: error message + original code + re-injected constraints
7. If validation fails → mark as post-repair validation failure
8. If validation passes → attempt build again

REQUIRED.description: Pattern that MUST appear in generated code. Failure to include → GENERATION_FAILED.
examples: REQUIRED: new MergeOptions() — use MergeOptions as the concrete options class
REQUIRED: using Aspose.Pdf.Text; (for TextFragment fixture creation)

FORBIDDEN.description: Pattern that must NOT appear in generated code. Presence → GENERATION_FAILED.
examples: FORBIDDEN: using Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.DataSources — sub-namespace does not exist
FORBIDDEN: new PluginOptions() — PluginOptions is abstract

TEMPLATE_HINT.description: Guidance included in initial generation prompt only. NOT re-injected into repair prompts.
TEMPLATE_HINT.risk: HIGH — patterns in template_hints can be lost during repair (confirmed in FP-005)
TEMPLATE_HINT.recommendation: Promote any template_hint that describes a structural pattern to REQUIRED

phase_1.action: Add per_type_constraints to ALL family YAMLs. Update packet_builder.py to read from config.

phase_2.action: Implement _validate_code_from_constraints() in code_generator.py. Apply to all families.

phase_3.action: Add per_type_constraints for email and slides before their pilot launches.
